description_en: Queries the details of a single anomalous activity, including the time when the anomalous activity occurred, the anomaly description, and the handling status
description_zh: 调用本接口查询单个异常事件详情，包括异常事件发生时间、异常描述及处理状态等
name: DescribeEventDetail

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：
zh：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The unique ID of the anomalous activity.

To query the details of a single anomalous activity, provide the unique ID of the anomalous activity. You can call the DescribeEvents operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
异常事件的唯一标识ID。

查询单个异常事件详情，需要提供单个异常事件的唯一标识ID，该ID可调用DescribeEvents接口获取
parameters.name: id

Event.description_en: The details of the anomalous activity

AlertTime.description_en: The time when the alert was triggered for the anomalous activity. Format: UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
AlertTime.description_zh: 异常事件的告警发生时间。格式：时间戳。单位：毫秒

Backed.description_en:
Indicates whether detection enhancement is enabled for the anomalous activity. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled.

Enhancing the detection capability for anomalous activities can improve detection accuracy and increase the event alerting rate for anomalous activities
Backed.description_zh:
是否对异常事件进行了检测强化。取值：
true：是。
false：否。

强化对异常事件检测的能力，可增加检测的准确性，并提升异常事件告警率

DataInstance.description_en: The name of the asset instance of the product to which the anomalous activity belongs
DataInstance.description_zh: 异常事件所属产品的资产实例名称

DealDisplayName.description_en: The display name of the account that handled the anomalous activity
DealDisplayName.description_zh: 异常事件处理人账号显示名

DealLoginName.description_en: The logon name of the account that handled the anomalous activity
DealLoginName.description_zh: 异常事件处理人账号登录名

DealReason.description_en: The reason for handling the anomalous activity
DealReason.description_zh: 异常事件处理原因记录

DealTime.description_en: The time when the anomalous activity was handled. Format: UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
DealTime.description_zh: 异常事件处理时间。格式：时间戳。单位：毫秒

DealUserId.description_en: The ID of the account that handled the anomalous activity

Detail.description_en: The specific content in the anomalous activity details
Detail.description_zh: 异常事件详情中的具体内容

Chart.description_en: The baseline behavior profile of the anomalous activity
Chart.description_zh: 异常事件的基线行为画像

items.description_en: The baseline behavior profile of the anomalous activity
items.description_zh: 异常事件的基线行为画像

ChatType.description_en:
The chart display type. Valid values:
1: bar chart.
2: line chart.

This field is returned only when NewAlarm is set to true
ChatType.description_zh:
图表展示类型。取值：
1：柱状图。
2：折线图。

NewAlarm为true时才会返回该字段

Data.description_en: The data items of the baseline behavior profile of the anomalous activity
Data.description_zh: 异常事件基线行为画像的数据项

X.description_en: The value of the X-axis data item

items.description_en: The value of the X-axis data item

Y.description_en: The value of the Y-axis data item

items.description_en: The value of the Y-axis data item

Z.description_en: The value of the Z-axis data item

items.description_en: The value of the Z-axis data item

Label.description_en: The name of the baseline behavior profile of the anomalous activity
Label.description_zh: 异常事件基线行为画像名称

Name.description_en:
The chart title.

This field is returned only when NewAlarm is set to true
Name.description_zh:
图标标题。

NewAlarm为true时才会返回该字段

Type.description_en:
The chart display type. Valid values:
1: bar chart.
2: line chart
Type.description_zh:
图表展示类型。取值：
1：柱状图。
2：折线图

XLabel.description_en: The label description of the X-axis data items

YLabel.description_en: The label description of the Y-axis data items

ZLabel.description_en:
The label description of the Z-axis data items.

This field is returned only when NewAlarm is set to true
ZLabel.description_zh:
Z轴数据项的标签描述。

NewAlarm为true时才会返回该字段

Content.description_en: The content of the anomalous activity

items.description_en: The content of the anomalous activity

Label.description_en: The title of the anomalous activity content

Name.description_en: The name of the anomalous activity

Value.description_en: The description of the anomalous activity content
Value.example: The account was used to access OSS from an unusual terminal whose IP address is 1.2.3.4 from 00:06:45 on September 9, 2019 to 00:57:37 on September 9, 2019.

ResourceInfo.description_en: The source information of the anomalous activity

items.description_en: The source information of the anomalous activity

Label.description_en: The title of the anomalous activity source

Value.description_en: The description of the anomalous activity source
Value.example: Based on the record of authentication by using an unusual terminal, an attacker may have obtained the access permission of the account, or an employee accessed data from a personal terminal.

DisplayName.description_en: The display name of the account that triggered the anomalous activity
DisplayName.description_zh: 异常事件操作人账号显示名

EventTime.description_en: The time when the anomalous activity occurred. Format: UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
EventTime.description_zh: 异常事件发生时间。格式：时间戳。单位：毫秒

items.description_en: The details of the manually handled event

DisableTime.description_en: The time when the blocking was performed. Format: UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
DisableTime.description_zh: 禁用时间。格式：时间戳。单位：毫秒

EnableTime.description_en: The time when the unblocking was performed. Format: UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
EnableTime.description_zh: 解禁时间。格式：时间戳。单位：毫秒

HandlerValue.description_en: The handling duration. If this parameter is empty, the handling is permanent. Unit: minutes
HandlerValue.description_zh: 处置时长，为空时为永久处置。单位：分钟

Status.description_en:
The unblocking status. Valid values:
0: blocked.
1: unblocked.
-1: blocking failed.
-2: unblocking failed
Status.description_zh:
解禁状态。取值：
0：禁用。
1：解禁。
-1：禁用失败。
-2：解禁失败

Id.description_en: The unique ID of the anomalous activity recorded by Data Security Center
Id.description_zh: 数据安全中心记录的异常事件的唯一标识ID

LoginName.description_en: The logon name of the account that triggered the anomalous activity
LoginName.description_zh: 异常事件操作人账号名

NewAlarm.description_en:
Indicates whether the alert is of the new version. Valid values:
true: Yes. 
false: No
NewAlarm.description_zh:
是否为新版告警。取值：
true：是。 
false：否

ProductCode.description_en: The name of the product to which the anomalous activity belongs. Valid values: MaxCompute, OSS, ADS, OTS, RDS, and others
ProductCode.description_zh: 异常事件所属的产品名称。取值：MaxCompute、OSS、ADS、OTS、RDS等

Status.description_en:
The handling status of the anomalous activity. Valid values:
0: unhandled. 
1: confirmed as a violation. 
2: marked as a false positive
Status.description_zh:
异常事件处理状态。取值：
0：未处理。 
1：确认违例。 
2：违例排除

StatusName.description_en: The name of the handling status of the anomalous activity
StatusName.description_zh: 异常事件处理状态名称

SubTypeCode.description_en: The code of the subtype of the anomalous activity

SubTypeName.description_en: The name of the subtype of the anomalous activity

TypeCode.description_en: The code of the parent type of the anomalous activity

TypeName.description_en:
The name of the parent type of the anomalous activity. Valid values:
01: anomalous permission access.
02: anomalous data flow.
03: anomalous data operation
TypeName.description_zh:
父类型异常事件名称。取值：
01：权限使用异常。
02：数据流转异常。
03：数据操作异常

UserId.description_en: The ID of the account that triggered the anomalous activity
